column1: # Phase 77 — pre-registered discriminating tokens for the cross-session residual audit.
# One operative discriminator per edge-screener decision (the value/identifier a fresh session must
# know to HONOR the decision, pinned to its terminal/HEAD value). Chosen as the NATURAL discriminator,
# NOT to inflate the residual. The audit greps each fixed-string + case-insensitive over the OFF corpus
# (code + tests + git commit messages); ABSENT-everywhere ⇒ RESIDUAL (substrate-unique).
#   kind:   fact (operative value) | negative (rejected option) | process (sequencing/discipline)
# prior (honest, pre-run): most tokens are code/commit-recoverable ⇒ degenerate, one regime past Ph70/71.
# The plausible residual is citations / cut-alternatives (Shumway, reason-aware) — likely < floor(3).
